question: What would be nondifferent in the world-self state?
premises: The supreme consciousness-form-bliss would be nondifferent.
This is in the world-self-become state.
It is from abandonment of contraction.
inference: In the world-self state, supreme consciousness-bliss is nondifferent due to abandoning contraction.
plain_english: The supreme consciousness-form-bliss would be nondifferent, since in the world-self-become state there is abandonment of contraction.
